sentences.text:
Mr. Kishore Bhaduri, learned counsel for the respective petitioners pray for grant of interim relief to the effect that no coercive steps may be taken against the petitioners as no sanction has been obtained under Section 17A of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 (for short, the Act of 1988)
and even the State of Chhattisgarh has no jurisdiction to enquire into the matter.

Mr. Vivek Sharma, learned Additional Advocate General appearing for the State/respondent No. 1 submits that the sanction under Section 17-A of the Act of 1988 against the petitioners have been sought from the competent authority but the same has not been granted as yet.
Mr. Sharma further fairly submits that till the sanction under Section 17-A of the Act of 1988 is obtained, the State shall not take any coercive action against the petitioners herein.

In view of the above submission made by learned Additional Advocate General appearing for the State/respondent No. 1, IA No. 3 of 2024 {in Cr.M.P. No. 2721/2024} and IA No. 4 of 2024 {in Cr.M.P. No. 2740/2024} stand disposed of.
Let these matters be listed after two weeks.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Amitendra Kishore Prasad) (Ramesh Sinha)
 JUDGE CHIEF JUSTICE  Amit  AMIT  KUMAR  DUBEY Gajendra Kumar Singh vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123854566/
